$comment: Polyloom reconstruction quality test set. One controlled factor varies per case against the 01-baseline reference; every case runs with identical settings unless overridden here.

cases.description: Reference: three-quarter view, clean neutral background, even lighting, full silhouette.
Front-facing orthographic-style view. Reduced depth cues versus the baseline.
Strict side profile. Occluded far-side geometry must be hallucinated.
Dynamic walking pose with separated limbs and ground-contact ambiguity.
Arms merged into the torso silhouette. Tests recovery of internal structure without depth boundaries.
Cluttered background. Tests whether background clutter survives matting and attaches as a plane.
Low-key dramatic lighting with crushed shadows on the subject.
Tightly cropped framing; parts of the silhouette touch or exit the frame edges.
Flat cel-shaded rendering with outlined edges, outside the photoreal training distribution.
Strong wide-angle perspective distortion of body proportions.
